Expansin, best hit of AtEXPA7 (root-hair function marker; paralog Chr4g0057091 nearly as close); 75x next cluster in root-hair cl3 (Cervantes-Perez 2022 Table S9). No Medicago reporter.
Class III peroxidase, syntenic ortholog of trichoblast marker AT1G30870 (CP Table S3/S4); 57-63x in root-hair cl3 (CP Table S9).

Syntenic ortholog of Arabidopsis trichoblast marker AT1G30850 (CP Table S3); 29-53x in root-hair cl3 (CP Table S9).
Ole e 1/LAT52-family; ortholog of differentiating-trichoblast marker AT2G47540 (CP Table S3); 17-40x in root-hair cl3. No Mt4.0 match >=95% identity.
Best hit of AtCOBL9 (root-hair cell-wall function marker); only 2.5-4.4x in root-hair cl3 (CP Table S9).

Phosphate transporter; promoter-GUS in epidermis and root hairs (Chiou et al. 2001 Plant J, cited by CP Table S2, not re-read). Not cluster-specific in CP (1.0-1.1x). Paralogs Chr1g0167731/0167761 are 97-98% identical: expect multimapping. Do not confuse with PT1/PINNATE PENTAFOLIATA (UniProt A0A679A044).
Syntenic ortholog of AT1G11190 (BFN1, nuclease of root-cap programmed cell death; CP Table S3: cell death marker); 9-13x in cl4, which CP Fig 2A calls epidermis and the text epidermis/root cap.
Aspartic protease, ortholog of Arabidopsis root-cap cell-death marker AT4G04460 (CP Table S3); 3-8x in cl4; also xylem cl24/phloem cl25.
NAC; best hit of AtSMB (SOMBRERO, root-cap identity; 53% identity) but same PANTHER subfamily as VNDs; top in cl5 yet only 1.3-2.2x over xylem cl24/G2-M cl9 (CP Table S9). Cap call is a hypothesis.
Pectin methylesterase; 10-24x in cl5 (putative root cap). CONFLICT: its Arabidopsis ortholog AT2G45220 is an atrichoblast marker (CP Table S3/S4).

WUSCHEL-related homeobox, reciprocal best hit of AtWOX5 (QC identity); Osipova et al. 2011 Ontogenez studied MtWOX5 promoter-reporter in nodule meristems (abstract only; root QC expression not verified). Barely detected in CP nuclei (0.07-0.25 avg; no QC cluster).

Isoflavone synthase; promoter in cortex and lateral-root formation sites (Biala 2017 J Exp Bot); 1.4-3.7x in cl14 (CP). Inducible defence gene: state-sensitive.
Methyltransferase, ortholog of Arabidopsis cortex/atrichoblast marker AT2G41380 (CP Table S3); 2-4x in developing-cortex cl7. No Medicago cortex marker is better than low.

SCARECROW (reciprocal best hit of AtSCR; Mt4.0 Medtr7g074650); in Medicago SCR is also expressed in cortex/epidermis (Dong et al. 2021 Nature, via CP Table S2), so not endodermis-exclusive; CP: c19 2.7x, c17 1.4x.
CASP (Casparian strip membrane domain protein), syntenic ortholog of AtCASP2/AtCASP4 (CP Table S3); 171-183x in endodermis cl19 only (CP Table S9). Marks Casparian-strip-stage endodermis.
CASP family, best hit of AtCASP1 (59%); 114-228x in endodermis cl19 (CP Table S9).
CASP family, tandem paralog of the two above; 43-112x in endodermis cl19 (CP Table S9).
R2R3-MYB, best hit and syntenic ortholog of AtMYB36 (Casparian strip master regulator); CP calls it MtMYB070; 3.4x in cl19 (mock), shared with endodermis cl18 in inoculated (CP Table S9).

SHORT-ROOT (reciprocal best hit of AtSHR, 66%; LIS calls it PAT1-like); Medicago SHR studied by Dong et al. 2021 Nature (via CP Table S2); in CP highest in endodermis cl19 then stele/xylem cl21-24 (low counts).
Second SHR gene (Mt4.0 Medtr4g097080, 504 aa); the ann1_6/v1.8 model is truncated to 244 aa, so counts may be low; CP: cl19 2.4-7.6x.

Hydroxyproline O-arabinosyltransferase of autoregulation of nodulation; promoter drives expression in the vascular cylinder (Schnabel et al. 2011 Plant Physiol); CP 2.3-2.7x in xylem cl24. UniProt E9KID2.
ABA exporter; promoter-GUS in root vasculature and lateral-root primordia (Pawela et al. 2019 Plant J; Mt4.0 ID from that paper); CP 3.4-3.8x in phloem cl25.

PHO1 phosphate exporter (AtPHO1 loads xylem from pericycle); promoter-GUS in root vascular cylinder (Nguyen et al. 2021 Plant Physiol; Medtr1g041695); 6-9x in pericycle cl20 (CP). Reporter not pericycle-resolved, so not raised.

PHO1 family; promoter-GUS in root vascular cylinder (Nguyen 2021 Plant Physiol; Medtr8g069955); 5-9x in pericycle cl20 (CP). CP Table S2 writes the ID with a tab and underscore. MtPHO1.2 (Chr1g0187381) is not specific.
SWEET sugar transporter; 5-6.5x in pericycle cl20 (CP Table S9). Name conflict: not the best Medicago hit of AtSWEET12 (those are Chr7g0214181/0214191).
Secondary-wall cellulose synthase, best hit of AtIRX3 (84%); 23-25x in differentiating-xylem cl24 (CP Table S9).
NAC, best hit of AtVND7 (vessel differentiation); 3.5-4.6x in cl24 (CP Table S9).

bHLH, ortholog of Arabidopsis xylem marker AT1G68810 (CP Table S3); 3-8x in Xylem 2 cl23, a cluster that may be procambium.
